title: valeriana officinalis f. angustifolia
intro: Valeriana officinalis f. angustifolia, commonly known as a subspecies of the valerian plant, is a perennial herb belonging to the Valerianaceae family. This plant is valued for its health benefits, including its ability to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety and insomnia, and alleviate restlessness. The therapeutic actions of Valeriana officinalis f. angustifolia include sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various sleep disorders and other health conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic effects include valepotriates, valerenic acid, and isovaltrate, among others, which have been identified as contributing to its sedative and anti-anxiety effects.
